towns.name: Mossbottom
towns.where: the hub town where every mycelium thread of the Hollow meets
towns.art: Mossy green meadow hub at dusk, glowing mycelium threads in the soil, big mushroom lamps, round burrow doors in grassy hills (the rootlings' Burrows), a windy meadow, Old Twigg's cosy seed emporium, mossy stone and timber, fireflies.
towns.s1: Meadow (hub-meadow): a windy flower meadow area, 'listen to the wind'
towns.s2: Burrows (hub-burrows): round burrow doors in a hill, 'help the rootlings dig'
towns.lore: Old Twigg's seeds older than his customers; rootlings were here before the gnomes; Moss Fair stalls.

towns.name: Maizehollow
towns.art: Warm colourful plaza town: painted adobe and stucco fronts in bright colours, terracotta roofs, cornfields behind, papel-picado bunting, a bell tower with a hundred thimble bells, bright turquoise sky, golden afternoon light.
towns.s1: Plaza (ma-plaza): a dancing plaza with a bandstand, 'join the dance'
towns.s2: Pinata (ma-pinata): a hanging pinata tree and party stall, 'swing at the pinata'
towns.lore: The three sisters corn beans squash growing together; bells cast from a hundred thimbles; cacao beans as coins.

towns.name: The Sunsprinkle Isles
towns.art: Tropical island harbour town: thatched stilt-and-plank cottages in bright pastels, palms, turquoise water and white sand, steel-drum band stand, hammocks, a boat or two, bright sunny noon light, coconut stalls.
towns.s1: Beach (ss-beach): a sandy beach with driftwood and shells, 'comb the beach'
towns.s2: Band (ss-band): a drum band stand with steel drums, 'listen to the band'
towns.lore: each island has its own drum rhythm; crab parade each full moon; plant a coconut for your grandchildren.

towns.name: The Rainroot Reaches
towns.art: Misty Andean highland town: stone-and-thatch houses on terraces, a rope suspension bridge, woven striped textiles as awnings, potato terraces in many colours, a river with a canoe, snowy peaks and cloud, soft cool light.
towns.s1: Bridge (rr-bridge): a big rope bridge over a gorge, 'cross the rope bridge'
towns.s2: Canoe (rr-canoe): a river landing with canoes, 'paddle the river'
towns.lore: a potato for every day of the year in a hundred colours; spiders built the Canopy Bridge and charge a fly a year.

towns.name: Mistmoor
towns.where: north-west Europe, British Isles moor village
towns.art: Misty moorland village at drizzly dusk: grey stone cottages with slate and thatch roofs, a stone pub with a hanging sign, the Standing Stones on a hill, umbrellas and puddles, lit windows, soft rain haze, green moor.
towns.s1: Standing Stones (mm-stones): a circle of standing stones, 'make a wish'
towns.s2: Pub (mm-pub): the Crooked Kettle pub, 'pub quiz night'
towns.lore: it rains a little every day so the gardens are green and the gnomes own many umbrellas; a silent owl quiz champion.

towns.name: Olivewhistle Shore
towns.art: Sunny Mediterranean harbour town: whitewashed stone houses with terracotta roofs and blue shutters, ancient olive trees, an olive press building, fishing boats and a quay, cicadas, bright sea, golden light, bougainvillea.
towns.s1: Press (ow-press): an old olive press building with stone wheel and jars, 'help at the press'
towns.s2: Harbour (ow-harbour): a little harbour quay with nets and boats, 'cast a line'
towns.lore: thousand-year-old olive trees greeted as grandmother and grandfather; cicadas loud enough to time the nets.

towns.name: Birchbramble Steppe
towns.where: Eastern Europe and the steppe region
towns.art: Birch-forest steppe village: carved timber houses (izbas) with painted shutters and steep shingle roofs, birch trees with white bark, a wooden banya sauna with steam, wicker baskets of mushrooms drying, a big samovar, soft golden low sun.
towns.s1: Banya (bb-banya): a wooden steam bath house with steam, 'steam in the banya'
towns.s2: Mushroom Wood (bb-wood): a birch wood edge with mushrooms and baskets, 'hunt for mushrooms'
towns.lore: every samovar has a name; grandmothers keep mushroom spots secret; short hot summers.

towns.name: The Dunewhisper
towns.where: North Africa and the Middle East desert region
towns.art: Desert bazaar town: sandstone and mudbrick fronts with domes and arches, striped awnings, hanging lanterns, an oasis with palms and a deep stone well, dunes beyond, warm gold dusk light, mosaic tile details.
towns.s1: Oasis (dw-oasis): an oasis pool and stone well, 'toss a coin in the well'
towns.s2: Bazaar (dw-bazaar): a covered bazaar front with carpets and brass, 'haggle with a merchant'
towns.lore: dunes that whisper; a bottomless well; first price is a joke, second a story.

towns.name: The Greatcanopy
towns.where: West and Central African rainforest region
towns.art: Rainforest town under giant trees: round mudbrick-and-thatch houses with painted patterns, huge buttress-root trees overhead with shafts of green light, a great story tree with a circle of seats, big drums, lush ferns, warm humid light.
towns.s1: Drum Circle (gc-drums): a drum circle with big drums, 'join the drummers'
towns.s2: Story Tree (gc-story): an enormous tree with a ring of seats, 'listen to a story'
towns.lore: trees so tall some gnomes never saw the sky; Grandmother Tortoise tells stories under the same tree; drummers play the rain in.

towns.name: Thornacre Savanna
towns.where: East and Southern African savanna region
towns.art: Savanna town at golden sunset: round thatched huts with painted bands, flat-topped acacia trees, a wooden lookout tower, a big rock kopje with scratches (Sunset Rock), a waterhole, warm orange sky and long shadows, coffee pots on fires.
towns.s1: Lookout (ts-lookout): a tall wooden lookout tower, 'watch the animals'
towns.s2: Kopje (ts-kopje): Sunset Rock, a big rock outcrop with steps, 'watch the sunset'
towns.lore: coffee drunk from thimbles; elephants at the waterhole remember; a scratch for every gnome who watched the sunset.

towns.name: Spicepeak
towns.where: South Asia and the Himalayan foothills region
towns.art: Hill terrace town: stone-and-timber buildings with carved balconies and colourful painted fronts, spice terraces, sacks of spices in bright colours, prayer flags, a cloud monastery on the peak, chai stall steam, snowy peaks, warm morning light.
towns.s1: Spice Grinders (sp-grind): a spice grinding shed with big stone grinders and heaps of coloured spice, 'grind spices'
towns.s2: Monastery (sp-monastery): the Cloud Monastery on stairs with prayer flags, 'meditate'
towns.lore: terraces that grow so fast you hear them; tea grown on the monastery roof; cardamom cheers any pot.

towns.name: Blossomreach
towns.art: Blossom village: dark-timber houses with curved tiled roofs and paper lanterns, cherry trees in full bloom with falling petals, a koi pond with a red bridge, a torii-style gate, stone lanterns, soft pink-gold spring light.
towns.s1: Koi Pond (br-koi): a koi pond with a red arched bridge, 'feed the koi'
towns.s2: Blossom Grove (br-blossom): a cherry-tree grove with picnic mats, 'stroll under the trees'
towns.lore: four true seasons with a word for each rain; a golden koi seen once a year; shops close for the blossom picnic.

towns.name: The Monsoon Tangle
towns.where: South-East Asia monsoon and canal region
towns.art: Canal town on stilts in the monsoon: wooden stilt houses with tin and thatch roofs, a floating market of boats, a huge banyan, hanging paper lanterns across the water, lush palms, warm wet haze, glowing evening light, flower garlands.
towns.s1: Floating Market (mt-float): boats loaded with fruit and flowers, 'paddle round the stalls'
towns.s2: Lantern Bridge (mt-lanterns): a bridge strung with lanterns, 'release a lantern'
towns.lore: always warm and wet, plants grow while you watch; the floating market never moved back; every lantern carries a wish.

towns.name: The Coralscatter
towns.art: Pacific island town: low timber beach houses with corrugated and thatch roofs in sun-faded colours, red pohutukawa blossoms, surfboards on racks, rock pools and a surf beach, a cafe with a flat-white sign, turquoise sea, bright coastal light.
towns.s1: Rock Pools (cs-pools): tide rock pools with shells, 'poke around the rock pools'
towns.s2: Surf Beach (cs-surf): Breaker Beach with surfboards and a big wave, 'catch a wave'
towns.lore: island time: the walk takes longer but you find something on the way; beetles once rode one wave all afternoon; nose-touch greetings.
